assumptions: Synthetic coordinates in km, not GIS; line crossings are not junctions.
Finite source equivalent: 1000 MVA three-phase and 500 MVA one-phase short circuit.
Contract kVA approximated by coincident load kVA; not real customer contract data.
PV is fixed unity-power-factor equivalent generation; no inverter controls or time series.
No full population calibration or complete standards certification.
Rural hierarchy: 3 synthetic settlements attached to one trunk; local distance-bounded MST inside each settlement.
Trunk carries 20% of load; settlement buses carry 80%. All non-source buses are aggregate load points, not additional junctions.
Cluster count, requested 0.3 trunk-node fraction (clipped for village membership) and 20/80 load split are explicit research hypotheses, not design-standard clauses.
Initial conductor selection uses downstream aggregate demand at nominal voltage and 80% catalogue ampacity; this margin is a research assumption.
No real roads, terrain, LV transformers, statistical calibration or guaranteed voltage feasibility; OpenDSS remains authoritative.
Selected voltage rule profile: 10 kV; single-voltage unbalanced equivalent, no transformers/explicit neutral/protection.

load_shape.depth_definition: Number of graph edges from the source, divided by maximum feeder depth.
load_shape.boundary: Explicit synthetic hypothesis, not an empirical population distribution. Directional concentration is relative to the same incoming allocation; individual loads need not rank by depth.

phase_design.scope: Leaf-only synthetic phase assignment; local weight renormalization, not an exact global ratio or real circuit reconstruction.

equipment_design.selection_reason: Scenario construction, phase count, downstream endpoint capacity and observed usage frequency.

style_contract.scope: Supported controls and measured model morphology; not a learned style classifier or full engineering compliance.
style_contract.origins: User/inferred/default provenance, when available, remains in the design brief and experiment plan.

voltage_profile.label: 10 kV MV
voltage_profile.equipment_basis: Illustrative sequence impedances/current ratings; not certified insulation, thermal or fault ratings.

network_policy.thermal_generation: Possible in distribution (e.g. CHP), but explicit thermal units are unsupported by this generator
network_policy.transmission: Unsupported; not inferred solely from voltage or generator fuel

requirements.title: Voltage, frequency, region, phases, and modeling granularity are compatible with the rule pack
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: 0.38/6/10/20/35 kV, 50 Hz single-voltage balanced research models; 66/110 kV recorded for planning only

requirements.title: All user-specified total node counts, loads, PV, coordinates, and ranges enter the task contract
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: common fields and ranges are covered

requirements.title: Infer an unspecified node count from the scenario and load scale, and disclose assumptions
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: defaults/inference exist; no statistical calibration

requirements.title: Distinguish buses, junctions, load points, distribution transformers, and actual customer counts
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: optional total nodes and positive-load points are separate; reference_conditioned supports zero-load junctions, but equipment nodes have not yet been extended

requirements.title: Check rule prerequisites, units, intersections, and model capabilities, and list unsupported items
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: type and range checks

requirements.title: Each node coordinate has units and a coordinate system; label coordinates as synthetic local coordinates when actual GIS is unavailable
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: local coordinates in km

requirements.title: Form spatial clusters and load centers around residential areas, villages, industrial loads, and similar groups
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: urban/rural and village research layouts

requirements.title: Prefer short paths within feasible corridors, zones, exclusion areas, and length bounds
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: distance-constrained MST, without GIS corridors

requirements.title: Distinguish Euclidean distance, actual route length, equivalent electrical segments, and pole/tower spans
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension: length must currently equal the straight-line distance between endpoints

requirements.title: Record the straight-line coverage radius from the source, maximum supply-path length, and total line length together
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: lengths are available; the interpretation of supply-radius clauses has not yet been compiled

requirements.title: Explain supply zones, cross-zone connections, and spatial crossings explicitly; geometric intersections do not automatically imply electrical connections
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Loads are reachable in the operating graph, identifiers are unique, and no invalid self-loops or duplicate equipment exist
requirements.implementation_note: Single-source tree checks are available

requirements.title: The operating graph is a tree during radial operation; the physical construction graph may include open tie lines
requirements.implementation_note: Energized trees plus separate normally open ties are supported; DSS verifies per-phase opening at both ends and near-zero current. Switching strategies/restoration/N-1 are not yet supported.

requirements.title: Trunks, laterals, and service segments have explicit roles; branch counts, depths, and lengths suit the scenario
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: village trunks/empirical child counts

requirements.title: Sectionalizing switches, branch switches, and tie locations depend on load distribution and operational requirements
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Explicitly model supply-path independence, backup supply, or emergency power required by critical loads
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension; a single-source model cannot provide this assurance

requirements.title: Total load, power factor, PV capacity, and denominator definitions satisfy the task contract
requirements.implementation_note: Basic checks are available

requirements.title: Separate zero-load junctions from load connection nodes and sample load occupancy by scenario
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: reference_conditioned samples using explicit reference occupancy and topology conditions; transfer from a single example, not calibration of the scenario population

requirements.title: Represent conditional relationships among load type, capacity, spatial location, and trunk/lateral location
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: positive-load locations and weights are sampled in groups based on reference child counts and relative depth; joint spatial and equipment distributions remain uncalibrated

requirements.title: Distinguish installed capacity, coincident peak, demand factor, coincidence factor, and planning-year load
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: coincident-peak research model only

requirements.title: Load and PV time series have documented correlation, seasonal, and operating-condition sources
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension: currently snapshots with user-specified multipliers

requirements.title: Unbalanced studies require phase assignments and per-phase loads; a balanced model cannot establish verification
requirements.implementation_note: 6/10/20kV supports explicit phases, per-phase P/Q/PV, missing phases at terminals, DSS per-phase voltage/current, and VUF at ABC nodes; equivalent ground-return path, without explicit neutrals/distribution transformers; research.unbalance is a research threshold

requirements.title: Conductor material, cross section, impedance, rated current, and applicability conditions come from a consistent catalog
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: illustrative impedances and ampacities

requirements.title: Initial conductor selection considers downstream apparent power in each design condition and is finally checked against power-flow currents
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: estimates at load and full-PV endpoints

requirements.title: Thermal limits, voltage drop, short-circuit withstand, and applicable mechanical conditions jointly constrain conductor selection
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: current and voltage checks only

requirements.title: Distribution transformers are near served loads, with explicit ratings, impedances, vector groups, and taps
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Reactive compensation and voltage-regulation equipment have explicit capacities, locations, control modes, and action limits
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Switch rated currents and interrupting capacities match expected operating/fault conditions
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Power flow converges with complete finite results, balanced power, and actual load/PV matching the request
requirements.implementation_note: Available

requirements.title: Separate standard voltage checks at receiving points from network-wide research voltage targets, preserving applicability prerequisites
requirements.implementation_note: A restricted mapping is available

requirements.title: Check ampacity by phase, operating condition, and rating conditions; distinguish margins from thermal limits
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: maximum phase current/illustrative ratings

requirements.title: Assess customer peak power factor by customer category, capacity, special agreements, and metering boundaries
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: research mapping for non-agricultural HV customers without PV

requirements.title: Keep PV connection points, capacity denominators, inverter kVA, reactive capability, and control modes consistent
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: constant-power equivalent generators at unity PF

requirements.title: Specify reverse-power-flow permissions and connection constraints by project; do not automatically classify reverse flow as a fault
requirements.implementation_note: Connection rules pending extension

requirements.title: Check short-circuit current levels, protection sensitivity/selectivity, grounding, and insulation coordination separately
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension

requirements.title: Use appropriate models and calculation methods for harmonics, voltage unbalance, flicker, and dynamic performance
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension; snapshot power flow is insufficient

requirements.title: Select and record normal, peak-load/low-PV, and light-load/high-PV conditions according to research objectives
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: explicit paired operating conditions are available

requirements.title: Load-transfer or N-1 requirements need adjacent feeders, reserve capacity, and permitted operating sequences
requirements.implementation_note: Pending extension; not imposed uniformly on every feeder

requirements.title: Freeze the network and equipment in comparisons across operating conditions; change only explicitly authorized condition variables
requirements.implementation_note: Network fingerprint and load-transformation checks are available

requirements.title: Inverse design checks all operating-condition targets and protected constraints simultaneously for the same candidate feeder
requirements.implementation_note: Seed and uniform-scaling searches are available

requirements.title: Distinguish failure to find a target solution from a mathematical infeasibility proof; retain the nearest candidate and its gaps
requirements.implementation_note: target_unmet is available

requirements.title: Select statistical references by scenario/granularity and record units, independent feeder counts, and synthetic or real-derived provenance
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: J1/K1 with M1 held out

requirements.title: Validate joint relationships among lengths, branches, load occupancy, and equipment/load
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: marginal distributions; joint relationships are missing

requirements.title: Reassess statistical deviation after inverse modifications; reject or label samples atypical when explicit limits are exceeded
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: length distances are recorded but unconstrained

requirements.title: Evaluate duplicate rates, scenario coverage, and feeder-level distributions for batches; avoid assessing only successful samples
requirements.implementation_note: A unified statistical acceptance process remains to be established

requirements.title: Repair uses only permitted actions with prerequisites, preserving requirements, protective rules, and frozen parameters
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: upgrades/optional reconnection and rollback

requirements.title: Record triggering rules, modified objects, predictions, and actual results for every repair and search
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: traces and candidate results are available

requirements.title: Freeze versions of rules, catalogs, reference distributions, models, and solvers; memory does not automatically modify rules
requirements.implementation_note: Partial: snapshots, hashes, and memory filtering are available

requirements.implementation_note: Partial: final models and visualizations are available; no separate complete single-line diagram yet
